property_summary: For any uint56 _changeFee, after initialize(...) completes the contract's public changeFee equals the exact _changeFee passed in (reference); the mutant stores a shifted/truncated value so for some fuzzed _changeFee the getter differs and the assertion fails.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to changeFee so initialize sets changeFee to the upper 32 bits of _changeFee (uint56 truncated) by shifting right 24 bits, changing the stored value.
